metadata.name: Character Enhance
metadata.description:
[h1]Character Enhance[/h1] Independently configurable enhancements for Tainted Lost, Tainted Blue Baby, Tainted Eden, Bethany, and Esau Jr., plus familiar-limit, pickup-animation, and The Clog creep-damage fixes. Requires Repentance+ 1.9.7.15; this is the only tested game version. Other versions are unverified. REPENTOGON is not required.
[h1]角色增强[/h1] 为里游魂、里蓝人、里伊甸、伯大尼和小以扫提供可独立开关的增强功能，并修复跟班上限、拾取动画和拦路屎水迹伤害问题。需要《忏悔+》1.9.7.15，且仅测试该游戏版本；其他版本尚未验证。不需要 REPENTOGON。
Supports English and Simplified Chinese Mod Config Menu labels. / 支持英文与简体中文 Mod Config Menu。
